chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Ghazwan, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Perform salat over the one who is stoned from my Ummah, and over the one who kills himself from my Ummah. Do not leave anyone from my Ummah without salat.

key_terms.أُمَّتِي: my community; the Muslim Ummah of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ: salat; here, the funeral prayer offered over the deceased
key_terms.صَلُّوا: perform salat; here, the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Should funeral salat be performed for a Muslim who was stoned or who killed himself?
ai.summary: This hadith states that funeral salat is to be performed for every deceased Muslim, including one executed by stoning and one who killed himself. It emphasizes that membership in the Ummah entails the continuation of basic funeral rites despite grave sins.
